title: B2.2 Unit 7 quiz — City life
description: Concessão e contraste, even if / even though, o argumento em quatro partes, a cidade, mayor e pavement.

questions.question: Escolha a frase correcta.

options.text: Lisbon has a metro, whereas Luanda doesn't.
Lisbon has a metro, nevertheless Luanda doesn't.
Lisbon has a metro, despite Luanda doesn't.

questions.explanation: whereas junta duas frases que se comparam.

options.text: Although there are few lines, the bus is popular.
Despite there are few lines, the bus is popular.
Nevertheless there are few lines, the bus is popular.
Even if it rains, we'll go.
Even though it rains, we'll go.
Even it rains, we'll go.

questions.question: "Embora esteja a chover, vamos na mesma." Em inglês:

options.text: Even though it's raining, we're going.
Despite it's raining, we're going.
Even it's raining, we're going.

questions.question: Qual é a melhor ordem para um argumento?

options.text: ideia principal, razões, exemplo, conclusão
exemplo, conclusão, ideia principal, razões
conclusão, exemplo, razões, ideia principal
Inequality is growing in many cities.
The inequality is growing in many cities in general.
An inequality is growing in many cities.

questions.question: "O maior bairro de Luanda" em inglês:

options.text: the biggest neighbourhood in Luanda
the mayor neighbourhood of Luanda
the more big neighbourhood in Luanda

questions.explanation: Falso amigo: mayor = presidente da câmara.

questions.question: "O pavimento está cheio de buracos." Em inglês:

options.text: The road surface is full of holes.
The pavement surface is full of holes.
The pavimento is full of holes.
tackle
attack to
take on with

questions.question: Reciclagem (B2, unidade 6). "Não precisávamos de ter levado o guarda-chuva." Em inglês:

options.text: We needn't have taken the umbrella.
We didn't need taking the umbrella.
We needn't to take the umbrella yesterday.

questions.question: Reciclagem (B2, unidade 6). "A estrada devia estar pronta em Março" (e não está). Em inglês:

options.text: The road was supposed to be ready in March.
The road supposed to be ready in March.
The road was suppose to be ready in March.

questions.question: Reciclagem (B2, unidade 4). "Vamos mandar pintar o portão." Em inglês:

options.text: We're going to have the gate painted.
We're going to paint the gate by a company.
We're going to have painted the gate.
